unlisted_practices: Graph-based memory that keeps dated, person-attributed medication, diagnosis and measurement chains for longitudinal medical dialogue
Patient profile listing every recorded safety fact included with each question

screen.reason: The paper develops and benchmarks MedGraph, a graph-based memory system/architecture for LLM medical assistants tested on a benchmark dataset (MedMemoryBench). It focuses on model/system architecture rather than testing organizational deployment practices or safeguards.
